part_log.engine: ENGINE = MergeTree PARTITION BY toYYYYMM(event_date) ORDER BY (event_time) TTL toStartOfMonth(event_date) + INTERVAL 3 MONTH SETTINGS ttl_only_drop_parts=1

query_log.engine: ENGINE = MergeTree PARTITION BY event_date ORDER BY (event_time) TTL event_date + interval 7 day SETTINGS ttl_only_drop_parts=1

opentelemetry_span_log.engine: ENGINE = MergeTree PARTITION BY toYYYYMMDD(finish_date) ORDER BY (finish_date, finish_time_us, trace_id) TTL finish_date + interval 2 day SETTINGS ttl_only_drop_parts=1

error_log.engine: ENGINE = MergeTree PARTITION BY toYYYYMM(event_date) ORDER BY (event_date, event_time) TTL event_date + interval 30 day SETTINGS ttl_only_drop_parts=1
